assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent pixel-art sprite sheet for the existing Dragon Quest Unity game's post-battle level-up celebration. The input image is an identity and style REFERENCE, not a sheet to replace. Create a NEW animation asset. Preserve the exact character's recognizable face, hair, outfit colors, silhouette proportions, dark outlines, pixel shading, and RPG chibi pixel-art style from the reference. Layout: FOUR full-body poses, left to right, in one row, equal-width cells, plenty of transparent gutters, consistent character scale and baseline, no overlapping frames, no cut-off hands/feet. Aim for a landscape 3:1 canvas. Frames: 1 happy relaxed standing; 2 very happy raising arms in triumph, eyes visibly smiling; 3 joyful celebratory hop, hands raised, broad smile; 4 happy landing and cheerful raised fist/wave. This is a happy celebration, no combat or magic effect. Genuine transparent alpha everywhere around character, crisp sprite pixels, no ground, no shadow, no background, no gradients, no borders, no labels, NO TEXT. 'Up!' will be drawn by the game above the head and MUST NOT be baked into the image. Keep all four poses equal scale and spaced on a regular grid.
Character Aren: spiky golden blond hair, red scarf and cape, tan tunic over dark brown leather chest/arms, dark trousers and brown boots. Stow the sword at the hip so he can raise his hands, celebrate with a joyful smile.
